about_the_game:
Purchase this DLC to host The Hunger games. Other players do not need to purchase it to join.

2-6 Players | 60 Minutes

Recommended Age: 12+

Will you become the most notorious vampire, or will sunrise mark your doom?

As the Eternal Roses bloom, vampires awaken from their slumber to begin a daring race. Players hunt humans to gain victory points, fulfill hidden missions, and acquire roses while navigating a treacherous labyrinth. The more you hunt, the slower your deck becomes, making it harder to return to the castle before sunrise.

The game combines strategic deck-building with a timed race. Players must balance their hunger for points with their ability to make it back before dawn. Tempt familiars for bonuses, explore hidden locations for surprises, and decide whether to take risks or play it safe.

Outwit your rivals and return victorious before the sun rises and seals your fate outside the castle!

Key Features:

  • Strategic Deck-Building: Build your deck as you hunt and complete missions, but beware of slowing down.

  • Race Against Time: Return to the castle before sunrise or face elimination.

  • Hidden Goals: Fulfill secret objectives for extra points and strategic depth.

  • Dynamic Gameplay: Each game offers unique paths and challenges for endless replayability.
